# Mumbai Durga Puja 2026 Directory
> Mumbai Pandals — Your Complete Guide to 55+ Durga Puja Pandals in Mumbai

Website: https://mumbaipandals.devs.surf

## Purpose
This dataset and application provide details on pandal locations, historical significance, cultural highlights, transit routes, and schedules to assist devotees and cultural enthusiasts in their "Pandal Hopping" journeys across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai.

## Data Structure
The primary data is stored as a JSON array containing the following key attributes for each pandal:
- `id`: A unique identifier (e.g., `north-bombay-sarbojanin-juhu`).
- `name`: The official name of the Durga Puja committee/organization.
- `suburb`: The general neighborhood or district.
- `zone`: The geographical cluster (Western Suburbs, Central Suburbs, South Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane District).
- `venue`: The exact location or ground name.
- `establishedYear`: The year the puja was first organized.
- `highlights`: Key attractions, themes, or historical prestige.
- `awards`: Any notable awards won in recent years.
- `organizer`: The specific club or association managing the event.
- `metroStation` / `trainStation`: The nearest transit options for easy access.

## Pages
- Home: https://mumbaipandals.devs.surf/
- Schedule: https://mumbaipandals.devs.surf/schedule
- Circuits: https://mumbaipandals.devs.surf/circuits
- Favorites: https://mumbaipandals.devs.surf/favorites

## Features
- Browse and search 55+ pandals by name, zone, or area
- View exact distances from your location with GPS-based sorting
- Interactive maps with your live green pin and all pandal locations
- Curated pandal-hopping circuits optimized by travel route
- Get walking/driving directions to any pandal
- Save favorites and build a custom visiting list
- Puja schedule with day-wise timings

## Legal
This information is compiled for public convenience and cultural celebration.
